title: I Let the Jazz-Club Two-Drink Minimum Catch the Door Lead's Friends

parts.text: I paid the two-drink minimum at 8:22 p.m. and the door lead walked four friends to a rail with water only. The house card at the register said: MINIMUM APPLIES TO COMP LIST TOO. I was forty-one, weeknight regular, holding two stamped napkins. Lead Chris said, "Industry hydrates free." I pointed at the card. He shrugged. "Industry is the band." The friends were not on the list. I photographed the waters, the card, and the empty comp list. Then I asked the manager to apply the minimum as written. At 8:27 the manager asked why Chris's name was on a skipped-minimum ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The manager can see four waters on a rail against a minimum Chris posted.

social.video_title: Door-lead friends skipped the two-drink minimum — Part 1/2
social.description: Stamped napkins, four waters, and a comp list that was empty. I asked for the card as written. Would you have unstamped yours?

parts.text: Chris called it hospitality until the till showed four unstamped seats. I printed the ticket, the card, and the photo. The friends stamped. Chris told the alley the card was always about optics. Optics is a word leads use when water is in a still. Minimum policy now has a second line: INDUSTRY IS ON THE LIST OR IT PAYS. I hear the sax. Chris stamps friends. The rail finally has ink.

social.video_title: Industry is on the list or it pays — Part 2/2
social.description: Skipped-minimum ticket, four stamps, and a second line on the card. Was hydration ever four seats?
